en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Zurara Bin Ayn, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is no problem if there happen to be the resemblances in the houses when its heads are changed from it and it is left, what is besides that’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Zurarah ibn ’A‘yan who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The existence of al-Tamathil (pictures or statues) in a house is not harmful if their heads are changed and the rest is left.’”
